_doc: Weapons in hand (cq 234). Per character: the hand bones and, per weapon class, the weapon root's transform in the hand bone's space (4x4, column-major, metres). Per class: the pose it was made from. Per weapon: the bundled default (app/assets/weapons). Read by the Godot fight (fighter.gd) and the Filament previews (features/game3d/attach.ts). docs/game3d/WEAPONS.md.

sword.note: one-handed blade held forward and a little raised, edge down

greatsword.note: two-handed blade raised in front, edge forward

dagger.note: short blade forward and a little out, so a front-on card shows it

axe.note: haft forward and up, away from the body, head turned out so the blade shows its profile from the front

hammer.note: haft up the arm towards the shoulder, face forward

staff.note: upright beside the body, top slightly forward

crossbow.note: bolt forward, top up, held low

rifle.note: low ready: barrel forward, out and down, clear of the leg and seen side-on in a front preview; top up, hand on the pistol grip

shield.note: left forearm, face out and forward
